r: It’s a balmy 80 degrees F (27 degrees C) outside and it’s Time to Duel at YCS San Jose, Costa Rica!

As is often the case in our Latin American events, we’ve got many Duelists from a variety of countries: Mexico, El Salvador, Guatemala, Panama, Venezuela, Colombia, Ecuador and the United States, aside from our host country, Costa Rica!
Welcome to all the Duelists! It’s Time to Duel!
